oraclePolicy: The tool return value is never its own correctness evidence. Channels read: durable control/guard facts, confined-spawn counters, on-disk markers, World transcript/ledger, mock connection counters, /proc tripwire, host-pid liveness. A6-12 additionally reads the durable control ledger row set (decision/consumption/abandonment sequences), not the kit check label.

verdictBasis: Stop is now clean (0/11 consumed) and the deny/throw/allow/cold-recovery arms pass. The remaining non-passes are the documented Sticky Stop limit (no durable marker under this composition) and the exact A6-on + governed Goal-authorisation conjunction, which still has no instrument. No candidateClaimEligibility is asserted.
residual: The fence trip is 1/11; the release note discloses a residual window between the probe and the consumption write. My 11 boots did not land in that window, so its size is not measured here.
